## Service Portfolio & Details

### 1. High Pressure Jet Wash & Surface Restoration
- **Target Surfaces**: Driveways, patios, block paving, natural stone, brickwork, concrete, deckings, exterior walls.
- **Equipment & Process**: Commercial grade variable high-pressure jet washing equipment up to 3500 PSI, surface rotary cleaners, eco-friendly biocide treatment for moss and black spot removal, re-sanding for block paving joints.
- **Service Locations**: Luton, Dunstable, Bedford, St Albans & surrounding areas.

### 2. Pure Water Window Cleaning
- **Technology**: 100% pure deionised water reach-and-wash telescopic pole system reaching up to 4 storeys without ladders.
- **Included in Service**: Glass panes, window frames, sills, uPVC borders, and door panels cleaned every visit.
- **Frequency Options**: One-off deep clean, 4-weekly or 8-weekly recurring cleaning.

### 3. Painting & Decorating
- **Services**: Interior wall & ceiling painting, wood trim & skirting painting, exterior masonry painting, wallpapering, door restoration, surface priming and sanding.
- **Quality Standard**: High durability premium paints (Dulux Trade, Crown, Farrow & Ball), crisp lines, full surface repair before application.

### 4. Garden & Ground Cleaning
- **Services**: Overgrown garden clearance, hedge trimming, lawn cutting, weed removal, leaf sweeping, green waste disposal, patio tidy-ups.
